l1_words.meaning: a sticky substance used to join things together
a flat dish for serving food
a product used with water to clean things

pattern_explanation: The English word spelled the same as the Portuguese 'pasta' refers to food, so learners may expect the same meaning here. Check the meaning of each Portuguese word before matching it to an English word.
false_friend_warning: The Portuguese word pasta looks exactly like the English word pasta, but in Portuguese it means a folder for papers, not a type of food. Learners who trust the spelling may match it with the wrong English word.
